title: Beach Cleaning by Interactors
summary: A Beach Cleaning Drive was conducted at Juhu Beach with the participation of 15 Interactors from Classes 9 and 10 of M. P. Shah English High School on 1 October 2026.
description: A Beach Cleaning Drive was conducted at Juhu Beach with the participation of 15 Interactors from Classes 9 and 10 of M. P. Shah English High School on 1 October 2026. The activity was undertaken as a tribute to Mahatma Gandhi on the occasion of Gandhi Jayanti, while encouraging students to understand their responsibility towards society and the environment. Rtn Bijal Merchant and Rtn Derrick Angelsz interacted with the students and shared thoughts on social and environmental responsibility as citizens of India. The initiative provided the students with an opportunity to contribute directly towards keeping a public space clean and promoting environmental consciousness.
